organization: Hrvatska turistička zajednica / Croatian National Tourist Board
identified_problem: The Croatian National Tourist Board promotes Croatia as a year-round destination. Recurring Dalmatian wildfires near Split and Dubrovnik and coastal storm-surge exposure threaten the image, access and safety of core tourism corridors.
climate_exposure: Its mandate centres on the Adriatic coast and islands, where heat, wildfire and coastal hazards can disrupt access, force evacuations and damage the destination brand.
potential_pain: A major fire or flood during peak season can trigger booking cancellations, destination switching and reputational losses without timely, evidence-based risk communications.
evidence: Wildfire exposure layers and historical event intelligence for Dalmatia, plus coastal hazard mapping for storm-surge exposure.
recommended_message: Provide destination-level wildfire and coastal monitoring so the national tourist board can communicate timely, evidence-based safety guidance to visitors and operators.
fit_score: Tourism is a strategically vital Croatian sector concentrated on the fire- and storm-exposed coast, making HTZ a high-value target for hazard intelligence.

interactions.summary: Identified via official-source research; signal: croatia.hr is the official destination site of the Croatian National Tourist Board and promotes Adriatic and inland tourism.

next_action: Qualify: verify current public signal and select contact route
